sources.name: Crop Recommendation Dataset
sources.licence: not independently verified in this session
sources.collection_region: publisher describes India; exact sampling sites unverified
sources.decision: Not approved. No lab-unit or method compatibility established. Crop labels cannot be repurposed as fertility labels.
sources.download: Open source page, review the current licence and version, select Download and save the original CSV in datasets/raw. Capture dataset metadata alongside it.

sources.name: SoilGrids 2.0
sources.target: modelled soil properties; no lab fertility class
sources.measurement_method: digital soil mapping with quantified uncertainty
sources.decision: Do not use gridded predictions as independently observed farm fertility labels. ISRIC advises against local/farm-level use.

sources.name: LM_SoilChemistry_Raw_202503-202507
sources.target: raw chemistry and experimental treatment, not low/medium/high fertility
sources.measurement_method: requires associated manuscript and workbook review
sources.decision: Candidate for chemistry research only. Download API returned HTTP 403 in this environment. No Indian regional validity or independent fertility targets established.
sources.download: Open source page and use Download All. Extract LM_SoilChemistry_Raw_202503-202507.xlsx into datasets/raw. Preserve attribution, units, plot/time identifiers and original workbook. Do not randomly split repeated plot measurements.
